title: Pilot preflight attempt
brief: Measure the current live app, expose coverage gaps and propose the next decisions. Preserve full product behavior.
scope: Single-build live pilot; no A/B claim and no full 14-case certification.

cases.title: Launch closed apps
cases.reason: A disposable multi-app fixture and per-app ready criteria are not available. No personal apps were quit.

cases.title: Pan, minimap and saved view
cases.reason: Repeatable pointer/trackpad routes and camera end-state observer are missing.

cases.title: Move and group cards
cases.reason: A disposable layout plus group/drag end-state observer is missing. Personal arrangements were preserved.

cases.title: Window discovery and previews
cases.reason: A controlled changing-window source and preview-freshness observer are missing.

cases.title: Quit selected app
cases.reason: Safe disposable app/document fixture is missing. Personal apps were not quit.

cases.title: Edit and persist desktops
cases.reason: A disposable profile and persistence assertions are missing. Personal desktops were not edited.

cases.title: Settings and shortcuts
cases.reason: The settings variant manifest and visual expectations are not yet implemented.

events.message: Preparing live pilot; seven case families have executable subsets.
Pilot stopped: Cancelled by the operator.
Report ready for human review. No proposals have been accepted automatically.

environment.cpu_units: 100% = one CPU core; OpenPlane process only
environment.observer: Mach CPU counters at phase boundaries; AX polling for coarse foreground/start availability.
limitations: No candidate build or A/B pairs.
Live personal scene, not a frozen S/R/L fixture.
No presented-frame or first-pixel latency observer.
Background user apps remain running; no claim of isolated system load.
Trials are current-process samples; explicit cold/warm control is not complete.
